items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I don't think it was Delbert Lee, but we had a tenor player.

ctx.x: 1933 in the spring. And we were stationed in Columbus, Ohio. And Sy Oliver was there and Dick Dickenson and Slim Rhodes and Eli Robinson and -- these are trombone players. I only see -- the saxophone player, it was me -- I never could remember this whole saxophone section we had. I know Ben Smith -- Ben Richardson was there. But the tenor player I can't remember unless it was -- I don't think it was Delbert Lee, but we had a tenor player. And we only had three saxes at that time.
